== Update June 30, 2026 ==

=== Hot fixes ===

* Fixed an issue where players who start on mobile and buy Reforged on PC would still see ads on mobile.
* Fixed an issue that was causing hitching on mobile, particularly in outposts.
* Fixed a bug that was making it hard to press the "continue with ads" button on some mobile devices
